chunks: Such was the law of God among those before you; and you will not find any change in the law of God.

key_terms.الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا: Those who passed away / previous generations
key_terms.سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ: The way, custom, or decree of God

ai.seo_question: What does 'Sunnah of Allah' mean in the context of divine decree and history?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ahzab underscores the principle of 'Sunnat Allah' as the consistent, immutable pattern of divine governance observed in the rise and fall of previous nations, particularly the Ahl al-Bayt's experience. It serves as a theological anchor for believers, affirming that just as God's decree did not change for earlier communities, it remains unalterable for the faithful, reinforcing the inevitability of divine justice and the continuity of prophetic tradition.
